title: fix(pm): the contract review's item ④ rides the narrowing face too
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9RP3jSzSG3UJMVL5NFpFfad)_
Fixes #26527
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:契约复核的 ④ 设计判断现在也挂在收窄面(`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`),模板、简报与规则文本同步改成三面;申报面照旧无 ④。
- 为什么改:你裁了 A(评论 6442046166):只在运行时代码里收窄已发布接受集的 PR,复核也要对照 `main` 上的 spec 问「这次收窄是在消费端砍掉了一个已声明的能力,还是把 spec 自己的拒绝落实了」。
- 风险与回滚:只动复核流程的文本与模板,不动任何运行时;回滚即 revert 这一个 commit。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `REVIEW_FACES` narrowing 行(`fullReview: true`)与简报的 narrowing 专用 ④ 段;`contract-review.md` L22/L30。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --brief-template --face narrowing` 应打出 ④ 段(「the narrowing itself, read against the published spec on `main`」);`--face declaration` 的围栏内无 ④。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(GOVERNED_APPROVERS);席位已请总监契约复审,批准后席位落地;在此之前保持 draft。

## What changes

The maintainer's ruling on #26527 item 3 (letter A, ruling record 6442046166) hangs item ④, the design judgment, on the narrowing face of the contract review as well. A PR that narrows a published accept set in runtime code alone, touching neither `packages/spec/src/**` nor a governed path, now gets the same ④ the schema and rules faces get, in the narrowing's own shape: no `hits` files, so the judgment is of the narrowing itself, read against the published spec on `main` — does it take a declared capability away at the consumer, or make the spec's own refusal real?

- `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`
  - `REVIEW_FACES.narrowing` gains `fullReview: true`; `recordCarriesDesignJudgment` is unchanged and now answers true for that face, so the record prints `### ④ Design judgment` on `--face narrowing` (the declaration face, below tier, still prints three headings).
  - The `--template` notes name three faces and the narrowing scenario (the narrowing itself against the published spec on `main`); the declaration face alone is said to carry no ④.
  - The `--brief-template` on the narrowing face carries a narrowing-specific ④ instruction (read against the published spec on `main`; a capability declared and not delivered is an implementation gap, implemented or retired, never narrowed at the consumer) and a scope line saying ④ judges the narrowing over the whole-diff floor, lockfiles, generated output, changesets and prose not reviewed. The schema and rules faces keep the per-`hits`-file shape unchanged.
  - Docblocks on the face table, the record builder and the brief builder say the same.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md`
  - L30: 「④ 设计判断只欠 schema 与 governed 规则文本两面」 → 「④ 设计判断欠 schema、governed 规则文本、收窄三面」 (114 B → 118 B, same line).
  - L22: the record-shape parenthetical 「(schema/governed 两面加 ④)」 → 「(申报面外三面加 ④)」 (115 B → 111 B, same line). The card named L30 only; L22 states the same face set a second time and would have contradicted L30, so it moves with it — declared in the report as a within-file widening.
  - 55 lines before and after; no new line; every edited line under the 120-byte budget.

## Why

Faces resolve schema → rules → narrowing → declaration, so a narrowing PR that also touches a spec or governed path already carried ④; only the runtime-only narrowing fell to a face without it. That is exactly the face where the pm-dispatch principle 「声明而未兑现是实现缺口,补实现或退役,⛔ 不在消费端收窄」 is most easily broken (spec untouched, runtime narrowed first), and the review asked only whether the declaration line was spelled right. The ruling closes that gap without a new face or a new gate.

## Tests

Forced test edits, all in the self-test of `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` (`pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers`):

- Flipped: 「the narrowing face carries NO ④」 → carries ④ (fourth heading, fenced on `--face narrowing`); 「exactly the two path-read faces are full-review faces」 → the three at-tier faces (`schema,rules,narrowing`); 「the narrowing brief carries no ④」 → carries ④ in the narrowing's own shape (spec scenario, no `hits`-ONLY rule, no angle brackets, no model identifier).
- Reworded fragments: the notes pin now reads 「on the schema, rules and narrowing faces」 and 「the declaration face alone carries no ④」; the brief face pin covers `narrowing` too.
- Added: the notes name the narrowing scenario (template battery floor 28 → 29); the `hits` faces keep the per-file ④ shape and never the narrowing's (brief battery floor 17 → 18).
- Unchanged and still green: the declaration face carries no ④ in record or brief.

Self-test at `78af1243`: 219 cases pass, exit 0 (217 before the change). Mutation leg (one shot, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit exactly once, trap-restored, restored blob byte-identical to HEAD `462459281f4b`): `fullReview: true` → `false` on the narrowing row ⇒ exit 1, 5 of 219 cases fail (the three flipped pins and the two added ones). No build or dist is involved; the script runs from source.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's acceptance line 「`--template --paths packages/objectql/src/x.ts` with a narrowing face prints ④」 is not reachable through `--paths` alone: `reviewFace` reads the narrowing face off the `Clause-②:` line, which a path list cannot hand it. Measured at `78af1243`: `--template --paths packages/objectql/src/x.ts` (no changeset in the list) prints the declaration face, exit 0; `--template --paths .changeset/x.md packages/objectql/src/x.ts` is refused, exit 1, telling the caller to pass `--face narrowing` (pinned before this PR). The face that prints ④ is `--template --face narrowing`, and it does.
- No other reader of `fullReview` exists outside this file (`git grep fullReview` at `78af1243`: record-recognisers.mjs only); the queue guard and `dispatch-gates` do not read it.
- The pm-dispatch SKILL.md rule the brief now echoes (「⛔ 不在消费端收窄」) is untouched.

## Verification

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` — exit 0 (self-test and scan); `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` — exit 0, 104 files clean.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
